QuestInfo.name: Mr. Do's Miraculous Medicine
QuestInfo.0: You got all the ingredients that Mr. Do needed. Hopefully he'll make it now.\r\nTalk to Mr. Do.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Do gave you the medicine. It will cure the Empress's illness for sure.\r\n#b(Return to Ereve and deliver Mr. Do's Medicine to Neinheart.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave the medicine to Neinheart.\r\nYou cross your fingers that it will be cure Cygnus.

0.0: Here it is. Deliver it safely!

yes.0: I already got paid for it. Go put it in a cabinet somewhere so you'll have it around 'just in case'.\r\n#b(Return to Ereve and deliver the medicine to Neinheart.)#k

no.0: This is perhaps the least logical point to call it quits.

npc.0: What're you standing around for? I thought that medicine was important.\r\n#b(Return to Ereve and deliver the medicine to Neinheart.)#k

item.0: Do you not have Mr. Do's Medicine?\r\n#b(Talk to Mr. Do in Mu Lung to get his medicine.)#k

lost.0: You dropped it? Are you kidding me? After all that?

yes.0: Alright, here, have the over-the-counter stuff. It's not as good, but it gets the job done.
